speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with fever and abdominal tenderness following childbirth. To help me understand your condition, how many days postpartum are you, and where exactly is the pain located?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old woman. The patient is in the postpartum period after delivering an 11 pound boy vaginally at 40 weeks gestation. She experienced a prolonged course during labor. She reports increased frequency of urination and uterine tenderness. She also mentions a decrease in bowel sounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Postpartum Pyelonephritis secondary to vesicoureteral reflux or obstruction from a large (11 lb) fetus; however, I must rule out uterine necrosis from prolonged labor or a urinary tract stone.
